verdict.rationale: Snyk's LLM-driven Remediation Agent generates a fix plan, applies fixes and verifies the result in a coding assistant or the CLI, with a human-in-the-loop mode (`snyk fix --agentic`). Snyk separately documents pull-request fix workflows for open-source vulnerabilities, but the evidence never shows the AI agent's fixes delivered as pull requests for review and merge. missing for 10: evidence that AI-generated fixes are opened as reviewable PRs in the SCM, AI PR drafting for SAST (Snyk Code) findings specifically, independent hands-on corroboration of AI fix quality.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI draft remediation pull requests for security findings that I review and merge

citations.quote: The Remediation Agent is an LLM-driven tool that automates vulnerability remediation in your projects. It scans your Project with Snyk, generates a fix plan enriched with Snyk security intelligence, applies the fixes, and verifies the result
Run `snyk fix --agentic` from your terminal to trigger a human-in-the-loop interactive remediation experience without an IDE.
Snyk provides actionable fix advice for vulnerabilities and supports workflows to fix vulnerabilities using pull requests.
